  molecule m

  atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

  connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id

  bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

  b.bond_type = '#' GROUP BY m.molecule_id

  m.label, 
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.element) AS elements
FROM 
  molecule m
JOIN 
  atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN 
  connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN 
  bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

queries.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    D.forename, 
    D.surname, 
    RT.time
FROM 
    drivers D
JOIN 
    results R ON D.driverId = R.driverId
JOIN 
    races R2 ON R.raceId = R2.raceId
JOIN 
    results R3 ON R2.raceId = R3.raceId
JOIN 
    lapTimes LT ON R3.raceId = LT.raceId AND R3.driverId = LT.driverId
JOIN 
    results RT ON LT.raceId = RT.raceId AND LT.driverId = RT.driverId
WHERE 
    LT.lap = (SELECT MAX(lap) FROM lapTimes)
ORDER BY 
    LT.time ASC
LIMIT 1
queries.final_sql:
SELECT 
    D.forename, 
    D.surname, 
    RT.time
FROM 
    drivers D
JOIN 
    results R ON D.driverId = R.driverId
JOIN 
    races R2 ON R.raceId = R2.raceId
JOIN 
    results R3 ON R2.raceId = R3.raceId
JOIN 
    lapTimes LT ON R3.raceId = LT.raceId AND R3.driverId = LT.driverId
JOIN 
    results RT ON LT.raceId = RT.raceId AND LT.driverId = RT.driverId
WHERE 
    LT.lap = (SELECT MAX(lap) FROM lapTimes)
ORDER BY 
    LT.time ASC
LIMIT 1
